requirements.text: * Approximately 2+ years of professional experience building and shipping production, consumer-facing applications with native Android technologies.
* Proficiency in Kotlin and modern Android development, including Kotlin Coroutines and Flow.
* Experience building user-facing features with Jetpack Compose and familiarity with Android Views and interoperability.
* Experience using Android Studio, Gradle, and the Android SDK throughout the application-development lifecycle.
* Experience consuming REST APIs and integrating mobile features with backend services.
* Familiarity with common Android architecture patterns such as MVVM and separation of UI, business logic, and data access.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows such as pull requests and code reviews.
* Ability to write testable, maintainable code and create unit or UI tests using tools such as JUnit, Mockito, Espresso, or Compose UI testing.
* Solid debugging and code-quality fundamentals, including the ability to give and receive actionable code-review feedback.
* Clear, solution-oriented communication and a willingness to learn and collaborate in a cross-functional environment.
* An ownership mindset with the ability to deliver well-scoped work, surface risks, and follow through from implementation to launch validation.
This is a hybrid role based in Palo Alto, California, and requires in-office collaboration three times per week.
* Experience working with Java or RxJava in an existing production Android codebase and modernizing code toward Kotlin and Coroutines.
